response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js — raising concerns about his readiness for the core C++-centric routing tile system.
strengths: Proven geospatial experience via open-source GISCollective platform
Strong track record in distributed systems and low-latency services (DLang, async I/O)
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No visible commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or map tile pipelines
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/Node.js, not the required C++ core
Limited evidence of distributed systems expertise in fault tolerance or consistency for navigation data
